# v1.10.2 — Mobile Projects refresh reliability

- Fixed the Projects tab appearing empty or stale after startup, sleep, or network changes.
- Subscribed the active Projects and Nabava tabs to the SyncBus 20-second fallback tick, in addition to WebSocket updates.
- Poked the sync bus on app resume to reconnect immediately instead of waiting through the reconnect backoff.
- Added up to three short-backoff retries for the initial project fetch; automatic refreshes remain silent on transient failures.
- Reload project data when switching back to the Projects tab and when the app resumes.

## Verification

- Flutter 3.24.3 analysis passed; all 9 Flutter tests passed.
- Mobile package version: **1.10.2+12**.
